method: Second anonymous git ls-remote HEAD for every G1/G2 lead that failed to clone. GitHub serves renamed repositories through redirects for git, so a credential prompt indicates a deleted, private or access-restricted repository; the GitHub web/API was not reachable from this host to confirm further.
